messages:
Maya: Heads-up: rolling out events_v2 -> replacing the materialized view used by analytics and swapping in the new consumer group. Target window tonight 22:00 UTC.
Owen: Outline of plan? want to ensure no double-processing during swap.
Maya: Plan: preflight checksum of current mv, spin new mv (events_v2_mv), run consumer group v2 to backfill last 7 days into new mv, do canary on tenant slice, then cutover traffic with leader-epoch handoff.
Priya: Can we avoid full table locks? new mv built incrementally using logical replication slot plus snapshot catch-up. no exclusive locks expected.
Sam: Deploybot should create a HOLDPOINT before cutover so oncall can validate metrics.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: HOLDPOINT created at step "cutover-traffic-shift". Manual approval required to proceed.
Tariq: Rollback flow if consumer lag spikes or duplicate events: 1) pause cutover, 2) reassign consumer group to old mv, 3) replay missing events to old MV and run reconciliation job.
Priya: Add automatic watch for consumer-lag > 5m or processed-count-delta > 2x -> auto-pause.
canary-bot: canary-bot: canary rule registered: consumer_lag_threshold=300s, processed_delta_factor=2. Alerts to #eng-oncall.
Owen: Need service pin for analytics-readers to v3.1.0 to avoid reading new column names mid-cutover. Sam can you pin?
Sam: I'll pin analytics readers and edge-cache until 01:00 UTC. Command used:
```
service-pin set analytics-reader v3.1.0 --until=2026-03-02T01:00:00Z
```
Maya: Preflight checklist: checksum job (complete), replication slot health (ok), consumer v2 in dry-run mode (ok), MV build at 60% for 7d backfill.
Priya: Dry-run noticed a schema mismatch on event.payload.version field in ~0.03% rows. We'll run a lightweight normalizer before final backfill.
Tariq: Add small-fix migration script: normalize_event_version.sql snippet:
```
UPDATE events SET payload = jsonb_set(payload, '{version}', '"1"') WHERE (payload->>'version') IS NULL;
```
Sam: Good. Also advise enabling idempotency tokens check in consumer v2 for the canary tenants.
Maya: Canary slice = tenant_ids 2000-2020 only for 20 minutes. HOLDPOINT will require explicit ack after metrics look good.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: created watch: mv_build_time_per_chunk > 10s -> PAUSE and notify #eng-oncall.
Owen: Oncall pls watch consumer-lag, duplicate-event count, and analytics query latency p99.
Priya: I'll monitor reconciliation diffs and edge cache miss rates.
canary-bot: canary-bot: canary started at 22:05 UTC on tenant slice 2000-2020. Will report every 2 minutes.
Maya: Noted. @oncall please ack when ready.
Sam: acked, monitoring.
Owen: At 22:12 we see small spike in analytics p99 (from 120ms -> 420ms) coincident with MV chunk apply on shard 4.
Priya: MV chunk apply median 1.2s but one tail statement 11s triggered the mv_build_time watch. deploy-bot auto-paused the cutover.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: PAUSE triggered by mv_build_time > 10s. HOLDPOINT re-established.
Tariq: Rollback step executed: reassign consumers back to old group for paused tenants. Command used:
```
deploy-bot reroute-consumers --group=events_v1 --tenants=2000-2005
```
Maya: Good call. While paused we'll reduce MV chunk size and re-run chunk on paused slice. Also schedule a quick hotfix to normalize payload.version before retry.
Owen: After reroute, analytics p99 returned to baseline within 3 minutes. No duplicated events detected in reconciliation sample.
Priya: Normalizer applied to paused slice. Re-run chunking at smaller batch size.
canary-bot: canary-bot: resumed canary at 22:32 UTC after manual approval from Maya. Small batch size applied.
Sam: Watching for idempotent reprocessing issues. No duplicate-event alerts so far.
Maya: Ramp to 50% tenant coverage at 23:05 UTC. Keeping service pin in place.
Owen: Observed slight increase in write amplification but acceptable. Consumer lag stable < 45s.
Priya: Recon diffs are under threshold (0.1%). Good to continue.
Tariq: Final cutover will swap DNS routing from events_v1 to events_v2 consumers and mark old MV read-only. We'll keep a rollback window of 30 minutes post-cutover.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: final cutover executed at 00:10 UTC. Old consumer group demoted.
Maya: Post-cutover checks: reconciliation job started, shadow queries passing, no cache stampede.
Sam: Service pin removed at 01:00 UTC as planned.
Priya: Post-mortem note: increase default MV chunk timeout to 12s and add payload normalizer to preflight for future runs.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll file rollout notes and update the runbook with the new auto-pause watch. https://redwood.internal/release-notes/2026-events-v2-mv
Owen: Thanks team. Closing thread once logs archived.
canary-bot: canary-bot: post-rollout archive job queued to s3://redwood-ops/migrations/events_v2/2026-03.
